item.title: Stylophones - The Vintage Sound of Angry Bees!
item.description: video upload by Manitou Productions "#stylophone #electronicorgan #vintagekeys #vintagesynth The Dubreq Stylophone pocket organ appeared in 1968 and has achieved cult status. More recently the Stylophone brand has relaunched the instrument in a variety of supercharged formats. Today we're looking at the original UK version, the cheaper overseas knock-off, and the first reissue from 2007.

item.title: The M8 Tracker Reminds EZBOT Of The Octatrack
item.description: video upload by EZBOT "The amazing thing about the M8 Tracker is the tools set it offers you to achieve your goals. Today, I want to share some of my perspective on the device and show off a few tricks that really demonstrate that the M8 can be whatever you need it to be. We will discuss Dub delay's, arpeggios, and make some chill tunes." Additional EZBOT resources: https://www.patreon.com/ezbot

item.title: MDLR JAM 02 - Live 5U Modular Session
item.description: video upload by rimela "Live jam on the 5U system. This take focuses on exploring harmonic structures. Moog Muse provides gentle pads, while the 5U system shapes movement and tonal shifts. Recorded in one continuous pass."
